title: Choose the access composition
question: Three structures from the CD packaging, all inside DESIGN.md. Image generation is out of quota, so cards show schematics and the build runs code-led. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: The Ring Opens
options.lineage: Back-cover ring-dot growing into the front-cover ring
options.thesis: The tiny ring-dot mark grows with each digit until it becomes the cover's full ring.
options.viewport: Two-line tracked title top-left; small ring-dot mid-screen; PIN digits beneath; ring scales per digit, decoding adds concentric grooves, admission collapses ring to white type.
options.risk: One object carrying all state; scale steps must read as progress, not decoration.

options.label: Back Cover Ledger
options.lineage: CD back cover: empty field, corner ring, barcode credit line
options.thesis: The screen is the back cover; the PIN is the barcode, printed bar by bar as digits arrive.
options.viewport: Mostly empty dark field; ring-dot status mark top-right; bottom-left title plus prompt; PIN digits above a barcode strip in the thumb zone.
options.risk: Huge empty field can read unfinished if bar rhythm and type are not exact.

options.label: Disc Read
options.lineage: Disc face: concentric groove rings around a center hole
options.thesis: Grooves fill the viewport; the PIN sits in the center hole and each digit lights one groove band.
options.viewport: Concentric hairline rings bleeding off screen edges; title on an upper groove; four digits in the hole; decoding sweeps grooves inward.
options.risk: Closest to a literal disc; must stay flat linework, never shiny CD skeuomorph.
